status: Experimental fit; reference source blocks audited at integrated commit 9d8a9dec. Mass, power, tier and component prices remain proposals, not recovered engine facts.
reference_conditions: Base states without isotope stability, horde, uranium or veterancy bonuses. Isotope stability now applies 90% received damage as well as death-explosion suppression; not modeled as extra HP.

diesel-light.note: New shared scout motor; all physical values experimental.

scout-sensors.note: Shared 50-credit proposal. Reuse detection/shroud traits, not detection simulated by calculator.

light-tank-shell.note: Existing versus table is NOT the medium ShellHeavy payload.

medium-cannon.note: Shared scalar gun family. Carrier chooses single/twin cadence; full legacy source binding retains different reports and muzzle/recoil behavior. No caliber inferred for new designs.

medium-tank-shell.note: Must reuse full existing versus/effect package; raw damage alone is not equivalence.

field-artillery-mount.note: Fixed assembly, not a freely rotatable roof turret.

field-artillery-he.note: Not Juggernaut or mortar ammunition: preserve full projectile spread/effects and targeting.

allied-medium-hull.note: Shared scalar hull family for Challenger/Leclerc/Leopard; artwork remains bound to complete actor variant. 2TNK itself is not buildable.

field-artillery-hull.note: Light armor despite tracked graphics. Fixed hull/gun artwork, no free turret replacement.

tracks-standard.note: Shared provisional mechanical allocation removed from old hull values, not an extra retrofit charge. Engine movement template unchanged; hull limits turning.

walker-heavy.note: Juggernaut physically walks, but its existing engine Locomotor is sheavytracked. Artwork does not determine locomotor semantics.

tracks-light-artillery.note: No infantry crush: exact existing lighttracked locomotor, not ordinary tracked.

mortar-roof-carrier.note: Experimental China gameplay carrier using existing artillery artwork, not Allied weapon access. Proposed 200-credit mount, 12 turn speed. Offset, scale, recoil and muzzle on Overlord not live-tested; infantry Mortar FireDelay 15 retained as a trial.

roof-mortar.note: Existing BulletCA: speed 166, launch angle 92, inaccuracy 768, BOMB image. New vehicle price, mass and power are proposals, not inferred from 150-credit infantry.

mortar-he.note: Raw primary damage only, not DPS. Full impact/smudge/water effects belong to existing payload template; no compiler yet.

overlord-chassis.note: Main heavy carrier plus shared roof slot for an approved auxiliary carrier, bunker or speaker. Emperor 80% received-damage modifier is excluded from base state.

diesel-heavy.note: New provisional heavy family, not a formula derived from engine size.

heavy-twin-turret.note: Normal, nuclear and speaker artwork bindings must select appropriate existing turret sequences; no claim of arbitrary visual interchangeability.

heavy-nuclear-shell.note: Base nuclear Overlord price fits +800 hardware minus 300/CP. Full radiation/projectile/effect rules reused later; no nuclear motor implied.

firing-bunker.note: Empty module. Start crew is a separate design selection; price/mass added once. Empty cost/mass experimental. PDL composition uses ^AttackingCargoAndPDL; requires turretbunker artwork.

gatling-roof-carrier.note: Shares gatling weapon/ammunition. Complete legacy behavior includes sensor equipment, ground/AA spin-up and turretgat sprite; 50-credit carrier allocation is a provisional fit, not intrinsic market value.

propaganda-speaker.note: Existing aura/upgrade traits to reuse. +500 hardware minus 300/CP fits base price; mass and load deliberately expose speed residuals.

mass-production.note: Separate manufacturing selection, not chassis or physical equipment. Provisional 5% reduction of all hardware before global CP deduction; not the joint-fit optimum. No special per-design rebate.

dragon-chassis.note: Base price/HP/speed fitted. Firewall deploy behavior and Black Napalm remain source references, not implemented.

gatling-chassis.note: Legacy sight override 6c0; preserve as audit metadata, not a claim of standard sight equivalence. AA/ground spool-up not simulated.

flame-turret.note: Normal attack only; deployed Firewall has additional armaments and state changes.

flame-fuel.note: Raw primary warhead only; fire clusters, heat and garrison damage omitted from calculator.

gatling-turret.note: Ground cold-state representative only. Reload stages 12/8/4/2 ticks, separate air/ground charge, thresholds 1/3/5, reset delay 40. Full attack-state behavior not modeled.

gatling-gun.note: Ground range 6 cells; AA uses ChinaMGatt.0 with range 9.5. Not a single fixed weapon.

gatling-rounds.note: Raw ground damage 350; AA raw damage 660. Values are not DPS.

autoloader-turret.note: Same visible single barrel. Autoloading mechanism changes firing cycle, not barrel count. Baseline mount mass retained; hardware price includes autoloader. Global CP credit value applies.

nuclear-shell.note: First fit: same mass, no additional electric load; +300 hardware offsets 1 CP. Radiation, falloff and recoil need engine composition, not just damage copying.

discharge.note: Fixed payload-package mass, not physical shells; no duplicate Tesla electrical charge.

legacy_families.name: Gatling Overlord

legacy_families.name: Bunker Overlord

legacy_families.name: Propaganda Overlord
legacy_families.note: PropagandaSpeaker behavior. Not merely a cosmetic turret.

legacy_families.name: Nuke Overlord
legacy_families.note: OverlordCannonNuclear range 5c512. Nuclear ammunition is not nuclear propulsion.

legacy_families.name: Plasma Overlord
legacy_families.note: Two CHECMBeam.Overlord armaments. Do not use the commented obsolete OverlordCannon.Plasma weapon as reference.
